easy.def: A round shape laid by a bird with a baby inside.
examples: The hen laid an egg.
Birds sit on eggs.
A baby bird hatches from an egg.

more.def: An oval or round object laid by a female bird or other animal, in which a baby grows.
examples: A robin laid four blue eggs.
The chick cracked out of its egg.
Turtles bury their eggs in the sand.

easy.def: Food that comes from a hen.
examples: I ate an egg.
Eggs for breakfast.
Mom boiled an egg.

more.def: The oval food laid by a hen and eaten cooked.
examples: I had a boiled egg for breakfast.
Crack two eggs into the bowl.
Dad scrambled eggs for dinner.

easy.def: A small cup that holds a boiled egg.
examples: The egg sits in the eggcup.
An eggcup is small.
She has an eggcup.

more.def: A small cup in which a boiled egg is held while you eat it.
examples: The boiled egg sat in the eggcup.
Grandma has a blue eggcup.
He tapped the egg in the eggcup.
The eggplant is purple.
We cooked an eggplant.
Dad cut the eggplant.

more.def: A large, smooth, deep-purple vegetable that is cooked before eating.
examples: Mom sliced the eggplant and baked it.
The eggplant grew big in the garden.
An eggplant has shiny purple skin.

easy.def: The hard covering of an egg.
examples: The eggshell is hard.
I cracked the eggshell.
A bird came out of the eggshell.

more.def: The thin, hard outer covering of an egg.
examples: The chick pecked its way out of the eggshell.
Be careful not to get bits of eggshell in the bowl.
A piece of eggshell fell on the floor.
His ego is big.
His ego grew.
She has a large ego.

more.def: A feeling that you are very important or better than others.
examples: His big ego made it hard for him to listen.
The praise made her ego grow.
A good leader does not let his ego take over.
